name: story-video
description: A caption can wait for a spoken word instead of a hard-coded second.
detail: story-video ties visuals to the narration, then renders the result as a film. Changing the voice doesn’t require manually retiming every cue.

name: EventMapper
description: A message was sent. Which handler actually runs?
detail: Started in 2013, EventMapper follows C# references and message routes to draw connections that ordinary call navigation can miss.

connection.label: Compare with the agent-session dashboard
connection.title: 2013 → 2026: following hidden activity
connection.reason: EventMapper traces messages to their handlers. The later dashboard records hooks from running agents. Different systems, but both make indirect activity easier to inspect.

name: trmnl
description: On Friday afternoon, the trains make room for next week’s bin collection.
detail: An e-ink dashboard that changes with the day and time. Each source keeps its own cache, so a failed API doesn’t have to blank the screen.
